definition.en: The condition in which data and metadata can be retrieved by authorized users through clearly specified procedures and, where relevant, standard communication protocols.
definition.nl: De toestand waarin data en metadata door bevoegde gebruikers kunnen worden opgehaald via duidelijk gespecificeerde procedures en, waar relevant, standaardcommunicatieprotocollen.

en: Once the user finds the required data, the user needs to know how they can be accessed, possibly including authentication and authorization (GO-FAIR). One of the central goals of promoting data access and sharing is to improve the overall efficiency of publicly funded scientific research to avoid the expensive and unnecessary duplication of data collection efforts (OECD). (FAIR Principles - GO FAIR,go-fair.org)
